title: Information Technology (IT) Institute Pre-apprentice
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Information Technology (IT) Institute Pre-apprentice Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate foundational skills in IT support, including the ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues, set up workstations, and perform basic network configurations.
Apply effective communication techniques to provide user support, manage client interactions, and resolve IT-related issues in a professional and courteous manner.
Utilize problem-solving strategies and critical thinking skills to diagnose and resolve technical challenges in diverse IT environments.
Exhibit career-readiness skills, including resume building, interviewing, teamwork, and conflict resolution, to succeed in entry-level IT support roles and navigate the job market effectively.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (CIS71, CIS99, CG51); they are matched to closed-list CIS 71, CIS 99 and CG 51 and are not treated as catalog additions.
CG51 is printed with 1.5 units in the catalog; the state file stores 1 unit.
The CIS103 units (4) come from the catalog; the state file stores no units for it.
The award title says 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units; the catalog total of 10 units is consistent with that.
The Program Map (Spring Start) repeats the same four required courses, totaling 10.0 credits.
The career 'technology' is read from 'build a sustainable career in technology' in the description.
